verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a desktop CPU, but the vendor material in the pack never states memory type, maximum capacity, or bandwidth. The spec-page excerpt only confirms ECC support, which is none of the three elements the story asks for. The DDR5-6400 rated speed and CUDIMM support come only from third-party reviews, not the vendor's own numbers, so nothing in the pack lets a developer size memory-bound workloads from Intel's published specs.
